payload.note: Spectral reflection commutes with the mass-squared derivative defining the dipole Wightman distribution, so the incoming/outgoing dual-number crossing matrix is I rather than epsilon parity. The crossed five-to-four map has a positive full-rank signed Gram, while composing it with a universal epsilon parity makes that same Gram negative. Hence the six-point repair cannot be a universal one-particle Wightman-dual rule; it must be profile-selective, higher-composite, or nonfactorizing. Evidence: REVERSE_PHYSICS_BT_CROSSED_WIGHTMAN_DUAL_NO_GO_V1.
